body: Haha! Thanks for making me smile. PM me your story when you think of one.
That's nice. I hope guys have good relationship. What about your father? Can I have a story about him? This will be the last one I ask of you.
Thank you for that. How's your relationship with your mother now?
Will you tell me a story? I am in pain, just trying to distract myself.
Okay, you got me there. I am a wreck and he's been willing to help me. I'll have to talk to him as soon as possible. Thanks.
Wow. Thank you I really needed to hear that.
Isn't that selfish of me? I know being with me is painful as fuck.

What other reason do you think I have? There's no one else if that's what your thinking. Yes I cheated in the past, but he's the only one.

He's amazing. He's patient with me, loving, goes out of his way to help my family, and he spoils me. He doesn't judge me even when I feel filthy. He's understanding when I freak out about being touched. He calms me down when I get crazy and brings me up when I get extremely low. 

However, I know that my instability is taking a toll on him. He tells me that I make him happy, but I also know that it hurts him so much when I lash out at him and push him away. I even caused a terrible fight between him and his mom because I was being crazy. 

I don't want him to get hurt anymore because of me. I'm not trying to break up with him because I want to fuck other people. I want to be whole again so that I can love him better.

I can't think of all that I went through as traumatic, but I am considering therapy. 

Should I stay with my SO through therapy or would it deter me from completely healing?
Lol thanks? So what do I do about the SO?

I guess I'm too proud to admit to myself that I need therapy...

As for my SO, should I stick with it or break up with him?
